title: Demo Activities
description: Demo_Game main quest and side-activity definitions. Loaded at runtime by DemoQuestManager::TryLoadFromJSON. See docs/DEMO_GAME.md for authoring instructions.

version.description: SemVer string. Bump the major version on breaking field changes.

_comment.description: Optional free-text comment — ignored by the runtime.

mainQuest.description: Definition of the Demo_Game main quest (Tour of the Engine).

objectives.description: Ordered list of quest objectives. Only the current objective is active at any time.

description.description: Text shown in the quest HUD while this objective is active.

stationID.description: Teaching station that completes this objective on Interact (E key).

activities.description: Side activities available alongside the main quest.

title.description: Short label shown in the quest HUD.

type.description: Activity verb. station_scan is a legacy alias for station_interact.

specificStationID.description: For station_interact/combo_practice: only this station's interact counts. Empty = any station.

required.description: Number of events needed to complete the activity.
